mode: Independent read-only design risk review before module implementation; not an implemented feature acceptance
scope: Entire Studio: author document/project templates, editor feature modules, representation formats, host ports and execution backends remain distinct.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: The drama template declares a prose scene.md document type. The word scene/game must not grant Scene2D/Scene3D or engine execution.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Admit actual supported representation format/schema at each applicable operation, while retaining generic structured/prose authoring.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: Native Catalog and ProjectTemplate deny unknown fields. Adding module/representation requirements to the existing template JSON would reject the entire native catalog and alter content digests at an unchanged package version.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Use an independent versioned requirements contract or explicitly evolve schema/native serialization and lock/migration tests. Already-instantiated projects remain source-owned and do not resolve installed template catalogs when opening.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: Backend descriptor currently admits only scene2d plans 1/2/3. A runtime engine having 3D support does not implement Studio 3D author model/parser/editor/renderer/plan semantics.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Keep unsupported representation actions unavailable with reasons. Do not broaden old backend admission just to show a 3D label.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: Blank, literary, drama and software-design projects own their document types and template bytes and do not require a running engine.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Absent/unknown optional modules and unavailable host processes must not disable opening, generic parsing, source editing or ordinary Save. Separate action admission from project availability.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: Feature/template declarations describe requirements and binding contracts; they are not executable code or host authorization.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Static own-key/Map registry, exact identifiers/versions and bounded detached JSON. Reject unknown dependencies, cycles, unresolved implementation/ports and mismatched representations for the specific action. Do not dynamically import paths or execute scripts from a template descriptor.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: The recent authoring workflow proves source/candidate/render separation, while the overall UI still initializes multiple feature coordinators through a common bootstrap.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Expose named source/metadata/media/preview/process/navigation ports and per-module owner/dispose semantics. A disabled/replaced module must expire its pending approvals without stopping unrelated text editing or an already-running frozen backend task.

risksAndRequiredGuards.finding: Existing workspace v3 declares author layout and types; adding an optional feature does not itself justify a workspace format upgrade.
risksAndRequiredGuards.guard: Keep unknown future author bytes and existing backup/resource-package behavior intact. New persistent requirements must have explicit migration/archive semantics rather than relying on incidental directory scans.

unclaimed: Arbitrary project plugins or executable template support
Native/backend/device acceptance for the proposed module contract
